title: Engine adapter: jeff (GLiFormer 400M, auto device)
description: MIT code, probabilities per option, auto-selects CUDA, MPS or CPU, ONNX export. Check the weights licence before running.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: jeff answers a scored task

Scenario: jeff auto-selects its device after the weights licence is checked
  Given the jeff (GLiFormer 400M, MIT code) model with an ONNX export, and its weights licence checked before running
  When I run bd run --engine jeff on a committed task
  Then it auto-selects CUDA, MPS or CPU, returns a probability per option for every item, and studies/ records the answers

right_now_summary: The jeff adapter checks the weights licence, picks a device, and records probability-scored answers.
